creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 3, part 2 of 2: following other machines' groups without joining them. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 6 ("Groups over the link without joining them").

What: a peer request that lists and follows the far daemon's groups: those that exist, those made later, policy and member changes, deletion, catching up after a reconnect, with each copy saying whether it is behind. Following makes nobody a member, and a group's home stays its only writer. Today a replica exists only for a group with a local member (crates/muster-msg/src/across.rs; `tell` in crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs sends to members' machines). Settle how a followed group behaves after a long disconnect (an open question in the MIP); record the answer on this card and in docs/architecture.md.

Proves, in the --ssh tier: a laptop client sees a conversation between two devenv agents, including a group made while the link was down.
title: MIP-10 stage 3b: following other machines' groups without joining
